preconditions.expression: all(32 <= ord(c) <= 127 for line in input for c in line)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input are within the ASCII range 32 to 127.
Each line contains at least one non-space character.
Each line contains at least one non-space, non-newline character.

preconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('#') or line.strip() != '' for line in input)
preconditions.description: Each line is either an amplifying line (starts with '#') or contains non-space characters.

postconditions.expression:
output == ''.join(['
' + line if line.strip() != '' else '' for line in input]).strip()
postconditions.description: The output is the concatenation of all non-amplifying lines, with spaces removed, and newlines preserved only between non-amplifying lines.
